answer: The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in oasis, expire in velvet, and ridge lists each expiry. An copycat running 137 aliases as a result needs 62 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1430 identities would post 1559 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
